sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:145

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:145:1
items.html: All the Mochin departed entirely, as is known, for after every coupling the Mochin return and depart entirely: Meaning, that these Mochin of the first intercourse suffice only for the duration of the time of the second half of the night, until the morning; and at the end of the night they depart entirely, and AHP are found returning and departing from them, and they remain again in GE [Galgalta ve Einayim] alone, namely in the NR [Nefesh-Ruach] of Ruach, as above. For the coupling that is in the Shema upon the bed sufficed only until the end of the night alone.
